backbone.en:
DFlash 2 draft backbone
5 transformer layers
starts from incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2
teacher features enter every layer's K / V
backbone.cn:
DFlash 2 draft backbone
5 层 transformer
从 incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 继续训练
老师特征注入每层的 K / V

selector.en:
Candidate selector
hidden projection + two codebooks
re-ranks the backbone's top-k
by (previous token, candidate) pairs
selector.cn:
候选 selector
隐藏态投影 + 两个 codebook
用（前一个 token，候选）配对分
给 backbone 的 top-k 重排序

backbone.en:
Backbone loss
weighted CE over 7 slots
w_k = exp(-(k-1)/7)
backbone.cn:
backbone 损失
7 个位置的加权 CE
w_k = exp(-(k-1)/7)

selector.en:
Selector loss
CE over top-k, same w_k
only slots whose truth is in top-k
selector.cn:
selector 损失
top-k 上的 CE，同一组 w_k
只算真值落在 top-k 的位置

footer.en:
Total objective per anchor = backbone loss + 1.0 × selector loss. The selector receives detached inputs, so its loss cannot move the backbone; the backbone loss never reaches the selector.
The teacher is exactly the model that will serve requests. Nothing here changes the target's answers: at inference every accepted draft token is the target's own argmax.
footer.cn:
每个锚点的总目标 = backbone 损失 + 1.0 × selector 损失。selector 的输入已 detach，它的损失不会改动 backbone；backbone 损失也不会传到 selector。
老师就是上线服务的那个模型。这一步不改变目标模型的回答：推理时每个被接受的 draft token 都是目标模型自己的 argmax。
